steps.title: Implement search box and filtering
steps.brief: Create a new branch (feature/sidebar-search). In the sidebar component, add a text input at the top. Use React state to store the query and filter the projects list by title as the user types. Update the rendering logic to show only matching projects. Add or update unit/integration tests to cover the new UI and filtering behavior. Run the test suite and, if all pass, open a pull request for the owner to merge.

steps.title: Review search implementation
steps.brief: Review the changes on the feature/sidebar-search branch. Verify that the search input appears, typing filters the project list correctly, existing functionality is unchanged, and all tests pass.
